title: shared_equipment v1
description: Equipment that moves between hosts and rigs (equipment/shared.yml). Host configs reference an item by id (shared_id) instead of copying it; see docs/host_config_interface.md#shared-equipment. calibration, filterRef, filterStack and date are copies of system_config v1's $defs (tests keep them equal).

id.description: Stable handle host configs use as shared_id. Never reused.

part_id.description: Optional link to hardware_library (<category>.<maker>.<model>). Omitted while unknown.

home_location.description: Where it lives when not in use.

current_location.description: Where it is now. A host config that references the item should be this host.

location.description: A host id (hosts/<id>), a rig id, or storage (optionally storage:<place>).

certificate_id.description: Certificate or report id; null for an in-house calibration without one.

due.description: Recalibration due date; a past date is reported as a warning.

filters.description: Photodetectors: the filter stack fitted when calibrated, in order. Any difference from the fitted stack invalidates the calibration.

filterRef.description: One filter element of a filterStack.

part_id.description: The filter's part design in hardware_library (category filter).

serial_or_lot.description: Serial or lot of the filter; null when the vendor gives neither.

date.description: ISO date, quoted in YAML (an unquoted 2026-10-19 loads as a date object, not a string).

filterStack.description: The fitted filter stack, ordered from the light side to the detector (e.g. shortpass, KG glass, optional ND). An empty list is an explicit bare detector.
